_comment: Tool definitions for Maya's Sarvam app (Amrita---We-4517816a-a47a), validated against src/lib/hospital/agent-tools.ts on 2026-11-12. Register each as an API tool in Sarvam (Build > Tools > API tool, lifecycle 'run' / During conversation). Do NOT paste the token into source control — store it in Sarvam Secrets.

endpoint.auth: Sarvam Auth type 'bearer token', credential = the Wellness workspace webhook token, stored in Sarvam Secrets. Fallback if bearer auth cannot be used: append &k=<token> to the URL.
endpoint.body: A JSON object whose keys are exactly the argument names below, e.g. { "doctor_id": "...", "date": "2026-11-16" }. In Sarvam's Body editor, insert each value with the @ variable picker. Tools with no arguments may send an empty body.
accepted_request_shapes: POST ...?tool=<name> with the arguments object as the body — recommended for Sarvam, one URL per tool
POST ... with { "tool": "<name>", "args": { ... } } — `action`/`name` and `arguments`/`parameters` are accepted as synonyms
endpoint.argument_leniency: Times: HH:MM, HH:MM:SS or with AM/PM ('10:30 AM', '4 pm') are normalised to 24-hour HH:MM. Dates must be YYYY-MM-DD, except date_of_birth which also accepts DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY and DD.MM.YYYY. `confirm` may be true or the string "true"/"yes". `days` may be a numeric string.

response_envelope.ok: boolean — true only when the backend confirmed the operation
response_envelope.data: object — present when ok:true; speak from this
response_envelope.error: string — present when ok:false; explain this to the caller
response_envelope.code: string — machine-readable failure code when ok:false
response_envelope.data (on failure): on a failed book_appointment / reschedule_appointment, data.alternatives is { date, slots[] }: free times on the requested day, or the next day within two weeks that has any (null if none)
response_envelope.correlationId: string — ties the call to Tringlo's AGENT_TOOL log lines

endpoint.notes: A failed tool still returns HTTP 200 with ok:false — read `ok`, never the HTTP status. Typical response time is single-digit milliseconds; a Sarvam 'Max wait' of 10 seconds is ample.

verification.summary: Every tool that reads or changes an EXISTING appointment requires a verification_id from verify_patient. A verification is issued only when the hospital's records match BOTH the phone number and the date of birth. It lasts 30 minutes, lives in the running server's memory (a restart means verifying again), and only ever covers appointments booked under the verified phone number. Three failed attempts for one number lock it for 15 minutes.

failure_codes.missing_identity: phone or date of birth not supplied
failure_codes.not_verified: details do not match the hospital's records (same answer whether or not the number is known)
failure_codes.verification_locked: too many failed attempts for this number
failure_codes.verification_unavailable: the hospital system cannot check identity right now
failure_codes.verification_required: a gated tool was called without a verification_id
failure_codes.not_found_for_patient: the appointment does not exist OR belongs to someone else (deliberately indistinguishable)

verification.post_call: After a reminder call, Tringlo applies a confirm/move/cancel only if its OWN record shows a verify_patient verification for that appointment's phone number issued during that call. Maya's identity_verified output can veto but never grant. Save verify_patient's data.verification_id into an agent variable named verification_id (Sarvam: 'Save reply into variables') so it is returned with the call result; a returned id that does not match is refused.
verification.limitation: Only patients in the hospital's patient directory can be verified. A caller the hospital has no record of can book, but cannot later look up, move or cancel by phone — that goes to staff.

tools.name: get_doctors
tools.description: List every doctor currently taking appointments, with doctor_id, specialty, department, consulting days and hours, and consultation fee (INR, may be null).

tools.name: get_departments
tools.description: List the hospital's departments, the specialties in each, and how many doctors are consulting. Use when the caller asks what departments or services the hospital has.

tools.name: search_doctors
tools.description: Find doctors whose name, specialty or department contains the query, e.g. 'cardio' or 'Mehta'. An empty query returns all doctors.

query.description: Part of a doctor's name, specialty or department

tools.name: check_doctor_availability
tools.description: Free appointment times for one doctor on one date. Call this before offering any time; never invent availability.

tools.name: get_available_slots
tools.description: Free times across several days, for one doctor or one specialty. Use when the caller is flexible on the date.

specialty.description: Exact specialty name as returned by a doctor search, e.g. 'Cardiology' (not a partial word)

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book a new appointment in a free slot, after reading the details back and getting the caller's clear yes. Does not require verification. Returns appointment_id and the doctor's remaining free times that day; on failure returns alternatives.

tools.name: verify_patient
tools.description: Verify the caller is a patient on the hospital's records, using their phone number AND date of birth. Required before any lookup, reschedule or cancellation of an existing appointment. Returns verification_id and the patient's name on record. Never reveals whether a number is known when the details do not match.

patient_phone.description: The phone number the appointment was booked under, with country code

tools.name: get_patient_appointments
tools.description: The verified patient's appointments (cancelled ones excluded), each with appointment_id, doctor, date, time, status and an `upcoming` flag.

tools.name: get_appointment_details
tools.description: One of the verified patient's appointments, including doctor_id (needed to check new times for a reschedule).

tools.name: reschedule_appointment
tools.description: Move one of the verified patient's appointments to a new free time with the same doctor, after the caller agrees to the new time. On failure returns alternatives.

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancel one of the verified patient's appointments. Set confirm to true only after the caller has explicitly said yes to cancelling. Read `cancelled`: true means cancelled; false means the request is with the hospital and the appointment stands for now.

confirm.description: Must be true; set only after explicit caller confirmation

not_tringlo_tools.call_transfer: A Sarvam core tool, not a Tringlo endpoint. It works only once Settings > In Call Actions > Call forwarding has a destination, on supported telephony, on phone calls. Wellness has no destination configured, so it is unavailable.
not_tringlo_tools.confirm_appointment: Does not exist. A reminder call's confirmation is recorded by Tringlo after the call from Maya's output variables.
